markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Only Invasive is in the conformal set, and the second model agrees [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu <1% | Invasive dominates |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 1.0, no flag | No input warning |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Invasive [F5] | Mostly concordant |

## Tissue evidence
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 3, 9) · ↑ invasive · Highest concept term, but spot check 0/20 [F2] · Unreliable
- **Scarce gland/tubule formation** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Low tubule score is associated with invasive carcinoma [F3] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical nuclear atypia score · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score, one region only · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion difference 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier. This case leans on mitoses and normal lobules, both Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- The input is a degraded simulated frozen section; the reliability score only modestly flags errors (AUROC 0.69).
- Calibration was tested on only 132 images; ECE 0.05 with a wide interval.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 3, 9**: confirm mitoses are really present; the concept failed its spot check.
2. **Region 10**: check for tubule formation versus a residual normal lobule.
3. **Regions 0, 4, 8** (x=0 edge): confirm the suggested medial-margin tumor [F7].
